reference.notes:
I implemented `NameRegistry` in `src/index.ts`, and every test passes: 14 of 14 public and 31 of 31 private.

How it works:
- **Setup:** the constructor rejects an empty key and stores the key with two pieces of state: which name each task got, and which names are taken in this registry.
- **Naming a task:** `name(taskId)` rejects an empty id. If the task already has a name, it returns that same name. Otherwise it computes the HMAC-SHA256 of the id under the key as lowercase hex. It tries `project-` plus the first 4 characters, then 6, 8, and so on, and keeps the first name that isn't taken. A task named earlier always keeps its name.
- **Separate organizations:** each registry keeps its own record of taken names, so names held by another organization never make a suffix longer.
- **One case the spec doesn't cover:** if every length up to the full 64-character digest were already taken, it throws an error. That's practically impossible, and no test reaches it.

None of the tests contradicted the spec, so I didn't leave any failing on purpose.
